title: Your Korean zodiac, and how this year looks
sub: Name and birthday, that's it. It's the thing that comes up the moment anyone in Korea asks how old you are.
waiting: Put in a name and a birthday and it'll come up.
out_of_range: This only covers 1920 to 2044. Outside that we don't have the lunar new year dates, so we'd just be guessing.
disclaimer: Just for fun. The animal and the season are really calculated; the fortunes aren't. The zodiac year turns at Seollal, so a January or early-February birthday usually belongs to the year before.

rat.name: Rat
rat.line: Read as quick and hard-working, never as the pest it is in English. A 쥐띠 right now is about 29 or 41.

ox.name: Ox
ox.line: Slow, but gets there. Saying you're a 소띠 in Korea is close to saying people can count on you.

tiger.name: Tiger
tiger.line: The one that gets called strong-willed most often. Anyone born in 1988 gets the Olympics brought up too.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.line: Gentle and quick to read a room. Tell a Korean you're a 토끼띠 and the first thing they'll say is that you must be easy to get on with.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.line: The one people actually plan around. Korean birth rates visibly jump in dragon years, so a 용띠 grew up in a bigger class than everyone else.

snake.name: Snake
snake.line: Sharp, and hard to read. Probably the most misunderstood of the twelve — it's not a sinister thing here.

horse.name: Horse
horse.line: Can't sit still, and that's meant well. 말띠 people are said to hate being stuck more than anything.

goat.name: Goat
goat.line: Easy-going, accommodating. There used to be an old superstition about women born in goat years; nobody says it now.

monkey.name: Monkey
monkey.line: Clever and good with words. Say you're a 원숭이띠 and people expect you to be funny.

rooster.name: Rooster
rooster.line: Early riser, says what they think. The two go together more often than you'd expect.

dog.name: Dog
dog.line: Loyal is the first word out of anyone's mouth. A 개띠 born in 1994 is 31 now.

pig.name: Pig
pig.line: Lucky, straightforwardly. Dreaming of a pig in Korea means money's coming, and the animal carries the same shine.

spring.name: 쑥국 Mugwort soup
spring.line: Made with the first mugwort of the year. You eat it to shake off the winter.

summer.name: 삼계탕 Ginseng chicken soup
summer.line: The hottest food on the hottest days. On 복날 there are queues outside the samgyetang places.

autumn.name: 전 Savoury pancakes
autumn.line: The whole family sits around frying these at Chuseok. Whoever's frying eats the most.

winter.name: 만둣국 Dumpling soup
winter.line: Eaten on new year's morning. Finish a bowl and you've aged a year, is the saying.
